title: Omastar 40/62 Fossil 1st Edition Pokemon 1999 WOTC Ken Sugimori Uncommon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Omastar – Pokemon Fossil – 40/62 – 1st EDITION
You will receive the exact card pictured. These are photos of the actual card, not stock images. Front, back, and close-ups of all four corners are shown.
Card details
Name: Omastar (Stage 2, Water) – evolves from Omanyte
70 HP
Set: Fossil (1999)
Card number: 40/62
Edition: 1st Edition – the 1st Edition stamp is visible on the left side below the artwork
Rarity: Uncommon
Illustrator: Ken Sugimori
Pokedex: LV. 32, #139
Copyright: © 1995, 96, 98 Nintendo, Creatures, GAMEFREAK. © 1999 Wizards
Flavor text: Spiral Pokemon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 77 lbs. A prehistoric Pokemon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible for it to catch prey.
Attacks
Water Gun (Water, Colorless) – 20+ damage. Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Omastar but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.
Spike Cannon (Water, Water) – 30x damage. Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
Weakness: Grass. Resistance: none. Retreat cost: 1.
Note for collectors: this is a 1st Edition print from the original Wizards of the Coast era. Fossil was the third English Pokemon set, released in 1999, and 1st Edition copies carry the small "EDITION 1" stamp rather than the unstamped Unlimited printing. The artwork is by Ken Sugimori, the original Pokemon character designer.
Condition: Ungraded, in the condition shown. Please review all photos closely and judge for yourself – the images are of the actual card and are the most accurate description of its condition. Corner close-ups are included so you can assess edge and corner wear directly.
